title: Value-Sensitive Delegation in Everyday AI Agent Use: Evidence from OpenClaw
abstract: arXiv:2609.22067v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Users increasingly delegate work to autonomous AI agents, yet evaluations typically measure task completion rather than the values users prioritize. Using Value Sensitive Design, we analyzed, with LLM assistance, 73,093 first-person Reddit posts about using OpenClaw, each for its human value, agent aspect, value fulfillment, and user outcome. The 21 values form six value groups, including Autonomous, Dependable, and Affordable Operation, Bounded Reach, Reviewability, and Equitable Access. Relative to each aspect's corpus share, values clustered not at the agent's outputs but at the operating conditions users set around a run. Values were usually met where users described what the agent delivered, in five of six groups, and mostly unmet where users described supervising it, in all six groups. translated_title: 日常AI智能体使用中的价值敏感委托：来自OpenClaw的证据
translated_abstract: 用户越来越多地将工作委托给自主AI智能体，然而现有的评估通常衡量的是任务完成度，而非用户所重视的价值。我们采用价值敏感设计方法，借助大语言模型的辅助，分析了73,093条关于使用OpenClaw的第一人称Reddit帖子，对每条帖子从其人文价值、智能体方面、价值实现程度和用户结果四个维度进行分析。这21种价值形成了六个价值组，包括自主、可靠且可负担的运行、有限的影响范围、可审查性以及公平获取。相对于各个方面的语料占比，价值并非集中在智能体的输出上，而是集中在用户为一次运行所设定的操作条件上。在用户描述智能体交付内容的地方，价值通常得到满足（六个价值组中的五个）；而在用户描述监督智能体的地方，价值大多未被满足（全部六个价值组）。我们将这种模式概念化为“价值敏感委托”。支持人类价值不仅需要关注智能体完成了什么，还需要……
tldr: 该研究通过分析73,093条Reddit帖子发现，用户对AI智能体的价值关注集中在运行的操作条件（自主可靠可负担的运行、有限影响范围、可审查性、公平获取）而非任务输出上，且这些价值在描述交付成果时通常得到满足，但在监督智能体时大多未被满足，由此提出“价值敏感委托”这一新概念。
en_tdlr: Analyzing 73,093 Reddit posts about OpenClaw, this study finds that users' values cluster around the operating conditions they set for AI agent runs rather than the agent's outputs—values are usually met when describing deliverables but mostly unmet when supervising the agent—a pattern conceptualized as value-sensitive delegation.
